title: Defective
text:
Defective. Unfortunately, this arrived defective. Some of the inside material was bunched up, causing it to be lumpy.

My first impression was both positive & negative. The comforter looks nice, and from feeling it I am certain it would keep one warm. If you like a heavier comforter, this felt heavy.

The negative would be that I expected the comforter to be much softer by hand. Sweeping my hand across the comforter was disappointing to me regarding its softness. I expected to be smoother, as well.
